Performs FileSet estimate, listing gives full listing.

## Synopsis

```text
estimate [job=<job>] [client=<client>] [fd=<fd>] [fileset=<fileset>]
         [level=<level>] [accurate=<yes|no>] [listing] [catalog=<catalog>]
```

Words without brackets are required, `[ ]` marks optional parts, `a | b` alternatives, `...` a repeatable argument and `[,...]` a comma separated list.

## Description

Asks the File Daemon how many files and bytes a backup job would save at the chosen level, without starting a job. The Director connects to the client, sends fileset and level and prints the answer; with listing every file that would be saved is printed as well. Without job= the Director offers the list of jobs.

level=, client= (or fd=), fileset= and accurate= override the values of the job. Only native clients are supported, not NDMP. Nothing is changed; for Incremental and Differential the catalog is only read to find the last matching job.

## Arguments {#arguments}

| Argument | Type | Values / source | Default | Flags | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `job=` | resource | from [`.jobs`](../dot-jobs/) |  |  | Job name. |
| `client=` | resource | from [`.clients`](../dot-clients/) |  |  | Client name. |
| `fd=` | resource | from [`.clients`](../dot-clients/) |  |  | Client name (as client=). |
| `fileset=` | resource | from [`.filesets`](../dot-filesets/) |  |  | FileSet name. |
| `level=` | enum | `Full`, `Incremental`, `Differential`, `VirtualFull`, `Base`, `Since`, `VolumeToCatalog`, `DiskToCatalog`, `Catalog`, `Data`, `InitCatalog` |  |  | Backup level. |
| `accurate=` | bool | `yes`, `no` |  |  | Accurate mode. |
| `listing` | keyword |  |  |  | List every file. |
| `catalog=` | resource | from [`.catalogs`](../dot-catalogs/) |  |  | Catalog name. |

## Examples

Size of a full backup of BackupClient1:

```text
estimate job=BackupClient1 level=Full
```

Every file the next incremental would save:

```text
estimate job=BackupClient1 level=Incremental listing
```
